_about: Phones from makers' own online stores other than Apple's, Samsung's and Google's (research-phones.json), read on 2026-10-05: up to 6 models a maker a market read from each store's pages, its catalog or the API its pages call, and the Shopify stores' catalogs (/products.json) read mechanically, up to 12 models a maker a market in the store's own order. Each read row's price was found again before it was kept, where it was read: on its page, in the store's API or catalog response, in a Shopify product's JSON, or after the store's own country form or store-view switch (Fairphone's, Mudita's). Unlocked phones only, at their regular price there; America's and Canada's before tax, Britain's, Ireland's and Mexico's with it.

Their plans, trade-ins, repairs and cover were not read: SLATE says the maker publishes none. A feature phone keeps the storage its maker states (HMD 110 4G, 128 MB as 0.128); a maker that states none (Doro) keeps none.
